title: Statement Delivery Charges on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
Paper statement delivery on Savings & Money Market Accounts carries a per-cycle charge that is set by tier, together with an age at or above which the owner pays nothing for paper delivery.

| Tier | Paper statement fee per cycle | Age exempt from the paper statement fee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | 0.00 USD | 65 years |
| Statement Savings | 2.00 USD | 65 years |
| Goal Builder Savings | 0.00 USD | 65 years |
| Money Market Account | 2.00 USD | 65 years |
| Premier Money Market | 0.00 USD | 65 years |
| Private Client Money Market | 0.00 USD | 65 years |

The fee column is the charge per statement cycle when statement delivery is paper at cycle close. The exemption column is the age, in whole years at cycle close, at or above which the owner pays no paper statement fee; the figure is 65 years on every tier of this product.

### Points of judgement

*On which tiers does paper delivery carry a charge at all?* On Statement Savings and Money Market Account, each at 2.00 USD per cycle. The remaining four tiers carry 0.00 USD.

*Does the exemption age vary by tier?* No. Every tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts carries the same figure of 65 years, so an owner who is 65 or older at cycle close sits on the exempt side of the parameter whatever tier is held. An owner of 64 whole years at cycle close does not.
